events.text: Invoice export falls over past about 50k rows because it builds the whole CSV in memory. Stream it instead. The output must stay byte for byte the same, and cover it with tests. Use a workflow if it helps.

The cause is `buildCsv()`: it pulls every row into one array, then joins it. At 50k rows that is about 1.4 GB before the first byte goes out.

I'll run this as a workflow, so each caller moves over on its own:

Where it stands:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Golden CSVs | **38 of 38** identical |
| Peak memory at 2M rows | 64 MB, was 1.4 GB |
| Month-end job | Moved to the stream |

The soak test needs CI's larger runners, so this has to go up first.
